$schema: trimmed, committed export of the ClaudePass Brand Book Figma file variable collections, derived from the design handoff's figma-tokens.json. This file is the source of truth internal/site/tokens_test.go checks site/retro.css against — if you change a token's value in retro.css, change it here in the same commit, and vice versa.

color-danger-dim.note: no code syntax set in Figma

color-signal.note: Light unusable (1.36:1) — never used on light pages

color-steel.note: UI / large text only, never body text

color-state-exposed.note: alias of color-danger in both modes

Radius.note: radius-none is the default everywhere; radius-pill is the one deliberate exception (Handle Pill, Badge — stage A2). sm/md/lg exist but are not applied speculatively.

Elevation.note: focus-ring-width is 3, not the 2 in an earlier figma-tokens.json export snapshot: 3px is the shipped, owner-reviewed value and Figma has since been updated to match.

Typography.note: Figma's Typography collection gives font-family-display as the bare family name "Press Start 2P" and font-family-body/mono as a shorter stack with no Liberation Mono fallback. The shipped site's fuller, practical font stacks win here — same shipped-value-wins pattern as Elevation's focus-ring-width — so this records what --font-family-display/body/mono actually resolve to in retro.css, not the literal Figma string.

vars.font-family-display: "Press Start 2P", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
vars.font-family-body: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
vars.font-family-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

derivedNotInFigma.note: Not exported from Figma. Each exists only so a spot in retro.css that needs a translucent wash over an existing fill has one named source instead of a fresh rgba()/rgb() literal.
